viewsWelcome.contents:
**A2UI Studio** — experiment with agent-driven interfaces.

Describe any UI in plain language and watch an AI agent stream a live, interactive A2UI surface.

[$(sparkle) Open Playground](command:a2ui.openPlayground)

Preview an A2UI JSONL stream from a file:
[$(open-preview) Preview Current File](command:a2ui.previewFile)

Learn more at [a2ui.org](https://a2ui.org).

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot via the VS Code Language Model API (no API key needed)
Z.ai GLM via the GLM Coding Plan (API key required)
Ollama running locally (no API key needed)
Remote A2UI-capable A2A agent (experimental, requires a2ui.a2aEndpoint)
a2ui.provider.description: Which AI provider generates A2UI messages.

a2ui.model.description: Model ID override. Leave empty for the provider default (Copilot: best available chat model, Anthropic: claude-opus-5, Z.ai: glm-5.3, OpenAI: gpt-4o, Gemini: gemini-2.0-flash, Ollama: llama3.2).

a2ui.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for generation. Ignored by Claude 5-generation models, which reject sampling parameters. Profiles in a2ui.config.json can override this.

a2ui.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per turn. Profiles in a2ui.config.json can override this.

a2ui.systemPromptAppend.description: Extra instructions appended to the A2UI system prompt (brand voice, design rules, preferred colors). a2ui.config.json can override this.

a2ui.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.

a2ui.baseUrls.markdownDescription: Custom API base URLs per provider — for enterprise gateways/proxies (AWS Bedrock proxies, LiteLLM, etc.). The studio also fetches the live model list from these URLs (`{baseUrl}/v1/models`), so nothing is hardcoded. API keys become optional when a gateway is set (the gateway does its own auth). Profiles in `a2ui.config.json` can override per profile.

zai.description: Z.ai-compatible base URL override (replaces the Coding Plan / general endpoint chosen by a2ui.zai.plan).

a2ui.a2aEndpoint.description: URL of a remote A2UI-capable A2A agent (JSON-RPC message/stream). Used by the experimental "Remote A2A agent" provider.

a2ui.autoRepair.description: When the model emits invalid A2UI messages, automatically send one corrective follow-up turn asking it to fix them.

a2ui.claude.effort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for **design turns** (new surfaces) on Claude. `high` balances quality and speed; `xhigh` for the most elaborate multi-page apps; `low`/`medium` for quick drafts.

a2ui.claude.actionModel.markdownDescription: Claude model for **action round-trips and repair turns** — the "builder" half of the designer/builder split. Leave empty to reuse the design model.

a2ui.claude.actionEffort.description: Reasoning effort for action round-trips and repair turns on Claude.

a2ui.claude.showThinking.description: Stream Claude's summarized reasoning into the agent chat while it designs.

a2ui.zai.plan.markdownDescription: Which Z.ai endpoint the GLM provider calls. A **Coding Plan** key only works with the coding endpoint and a general API key only with the general one.

a2ui.zai.reasoningEffort.description: GLM thinking depth (thinking is always on for GLM-5.x). `high` balances quality and speed; `max` is deepest and slowest.

a2ui.claude.refusalFallback.markdownDescription: When Claude Opus 5's safety classifiers decline a request, let the API re-run it on Anthropic's recommended fallback model in the same call (beta `server-side-fallback`). Disable for gateways that reject beta headers.
